newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Readington, N.J..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Treasurer of the Township at the Municipal Building, 509 Route 523,
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the Township dated April 15, 1997 and due (subject to prior redemption) on April 15 as follows:
Year Principal Amount Year Principal Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Township in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Township will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon &Scotland, Newark, N.J.

The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on April 15 and October 15 in each year until maturity, commencing on October 15, 1997. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting Vita Mekovetz, Treasurer at the Township of Readington, 509 Route 523, Whitehouse Station, N.J. 08889, (908) 534-4051.
